add-requirement-column.review: Keep registry/data wiring/admin defaults/field-specific verification. Keep the task trigger before paths exist.

admin-center.review: Keep server authorization, authorized-tab fallback, activation-only fetches, shell/panel separation, client-secret boundary and focused panel contracts. Complementary auth and UI routes remain applicable.

ai-instruction-authoring.task_condition: maintaining instructions, their routes, selectors or covered paths, including additions, moves and deletions
ai-instruction-authoring.review: Keep concise AI directives, single owner, narrow string applyTo, headings/bullets/code style. Remove obsolete Copilot-root exception/reference. Preserve prospective prompt coverage; no prompt directory currently exists. Add the accepted reciprocal maintenance procedure and retained AGENTS coverage.

api-contract.task_condition: adding, removing, renaming or changing an app-owned REST route, contract, or Schemathesis scope
api-contract.review: Keep REST/Schemathesis inclusion decision, bounded disposable-target contract, auth/CSRF/errors/schema synchronization, focused tests and available-stack verification. REST registry authority stays in route-security-policy; MCP stays separate.

auth-docs.task_condition: changing login/session/proxy/MCP bearer auth, claims, identity mapping, IdP deployment or local auth workflow
auth-docs.review: Keep each documentation destination with its distinct trigger, Mermaid alignment and provider-generic wording. These are specialized obligations under the common documentation rule.

auth-security.task_condition: changing authentication, CSRF, browser mutations, identity headers, session projection or security tests
auth-security.review: Keep browser apiFetch/header handling, identity stripping, shared CSRF helper and auth test scenarios. Delegate REST policy and MCP exclusion to route-security-policy; retain browser-versus-bearer qualification.

components.task_condition: authoring component TSX, with client-only rules conditional on hooks/events/animation and PDF exceptions preserved
components.review: Keep component structure/client islands, conditional client/server translations, reduced motion, images/PDF exception, async controls and high-frequency interactions. Consolidate general loading/animation rules in ui-ux; keep component-specific mechanics and reduced-motion helper here.

database-schema.task_condition: changing schema, migrations, seeds, database-backed JSON Schema, requirement snapshots, lifecycle dates or personal-data persistence
database-schema.review: Keep naming, snapshots, removal cleanup, sync surfaces, JSON Schema, erasure, docs, migration/seed flow and lifecycle-date semantics. Clarify metadata versus DDL authority; replace decorator naming examples with EntitySchema uniques/indices. Own scalar-FK exceptions. Consolidate repeated released-migration, canonical-doc and cleanup statements within their sections.

database-writes.task_condition: changing multi-table writes or assignment authorization for requirements, areas, packages or specifications
database-writes.review: Keep wrapper-level atomic ownership, transactional safety, deterministic-cleanup exception, assignment boundaries and focused rollback/ownership tests. Reference this owner from TypeORM transaction guidance; TypeORM manager/QueryRunner specifics remain there.

detail-pane-layout.task_condition: changing requirement inline/full detail cards, metadata or area-owner presentation in create/edit forms
detail-pane-layout.review: Keep fixed card order, no sidebar within the card, area ownership and non-editable form owner. Consolidate repeated card/order statements. Extend selection to shared cards and form fields; do not interpret the card rule as banning surrounding page action rails.

dev-http.task_condition: making authenticated HTTP requests against the development server, or changing its login/request helper workflow
dev-http.review: New conditional owner for every authenticated-development-request rule in the retired Copilot root.

developer-mode.task_condition: changing visible UI elements, labels, roles or layout, or Developer Mode markers, scanner, naming or runtime wiring
developer-mode.review: Own English developer labels and the desktop/compact/accessibility exception transferred from Copilot root and ui-ux. Keep marker updates, code-owned exact coverage, documentation trigger and production noops. Keep external rationale pointer conditional on runtime-wiring work.

github-actions-security.task_condition: editing GitHub Actions or Dependabot configuration, including adding or renaming workflows
github-actions-security.review: Keep external action SHA/tag resolution, credential exception and Dependabot ecosystem. Retire all instructions requiring or permitting workflow unit assertions; reference tests for the shared testing boundary.

help-panel.task_condition: adding, changing or removing a client view, its HelpContent or translation-driven help visuals
help-panel.review: Keep module-scope typed constants, view add/change/remove lifecycle, text/visual schema and translation-driven visuals. Collapse repeated placement rules and paired-language examples into the translations pointer; preserve relative help namespace.

information-assets-retention.task_condition: adding persistent business data, document sections, export payloads or stored files, or changing app retention
information-assets-retention.review: Keep asset classification, retention decision, documented exceptions, app policy/fixtures/tests and privacy-versus-retention separation. No policy retirement; branch on new assets before schema paths exist.

lychee-toolchain.task_condition: changing Lychee installers, workflow input, checksums, or dependency-drift lane/detector behavior
lychee-toolchain.review: Keep coordinated versions and both architecture hashes, maintained drift lane and relational executable-detector tests. Delegate action pinning to github-actions-security; retire workflow/version-alignment unit-test requirement.

manual-test-playwright.task_condition: changing functional/manual scenario coverage, Playwright specs or authorization fixture boundaries
manual-test-playwright.review: Keep all manual/spec lockstep, functional-versus-geometry scope, explicit maintenance authorization, chunk generation, role phases/storage and isolated fixture equivalence. Do not silently relax spec maintenance restrictions.

markdown.task_condition: authoring Markdown in the selected documentation paths
markdown.review: Keep Markdown style and lint conventions, 80-column prose, intact code/URLs, allowed MD013 exceptions and consistent table style. Scope stays documentation-shaped, not a new all-Markdown policy.

mcp-tool-contract.task_condition: changing callable MCP inputs, outputs, prerequisites or next actions, including shared backend behavior
mcp-tool-contract.review: Keep client-visible descriptions/schemas/prerequisites, both guide inventories and MCP tests. Delegate shared service boundary to its owner, without turning documentation into the callable contract.

next-runtime.task_condition: creating or moving API routes, changing server runtime, DB script setup or API-documentation security headers
next-runtime.review: Keep Node server runtime, wrapper access, platform independence, explicit connection contract/prodlike flow and header-surface synchronization. Categorical Turbopack second-segment exclusion is unresolved: existing REST authoring docs and routes use requirements/[id]. Record a separate decision; preserve current wording pending it.

node-version.task_condition: changing any file that sets or documents a Node version, including documented pins before all locations are known
node-version.review: Keep coordinated Node major, discovery of all pins, verification and documented exceptions. Use rg and current .nvmrc/package/container/CI inputs; retire the absent generated bundled/NODE_VERSION example. Do not freeze the example major as a permanent policy or rewrite digest pinning.

operator-upgrade-notes.task_condition: correcting existing operator-upgrade-note content within explicit task scope
operator-upgrade-notes.review: Keep automation ownership, explicit correction-only scope and preservation of markers/history. No broad deployment editing rule is added.

package-updates.task_condition: changing root dependencies, overrides or related peer/tool/browser versions
package-updates.review: Keep intentional specifiers, override review, peer compatibility, Biome schema/type-major alignment, browser installation and check/audit commands. Read current package metadata for versions; preserve existing user authorization rules.

pester.task_condition: authoring PowerShell tests or changing their isolated runners and execution gates
pester.review: Keep all safety, syntax, scope, mocking, naming, folder, data-driven, opt-in/container and CI rules. Only remove singleton braces; CI permissions and result publication are execution requirements, not instructions to unit-test YAML.

privacy-display-name.task_condition: rendering person/actor labels in UI, report/PDF/CSV or user-facing assertions; not durable identity or internal logs
privacy-display-name.review: Keep localized sentinel-safe public names, durable-key/internal-log exclusion, enforcement-test protection and positive anonymous rendering cases. Cover CSV API producers explicitly; do not extend formatting into erasure identity matching.

reports.task_condition: changing report templates, sections, engines, routes, styling, output or PDF actions
reports.review: Keep template/renderer ownership, server PDF/CSP, section/type/engine lifecycle, archiving review differences, locale-safe links and specialized docs. Preserve PDF image/rendering exception; locale key synchronization delegates to translations.

requirement-lifecycle-policy.task_condition: changing edit, archiving, transition, restore, reactivate or delete-draft decisions
requirement-lifecycle-policy.review: Keep incremental pure decisions, status constants, DAL lock/transaction ownership, no duplicate precondition reads, route transport ownership and focused tests. No unrelated extraction project is authorized.

requirement-service-boundary.task_condition: changing REST/MCP workflow overlap or a shared RequirementsService workflow
requirement-service-boundary.review: Keep all enumerated overlaps and direct-DAL/streaming exceptions. Own HTTP-versus-service responsibility for shared workflows; REST wrapper specifics remain in secure-mutation-routes.

requirements-table.task_condition: changing requirement table columns/defaults, filters, sort, width persistence or resizing
requirements-table.review: Keep custom-table choice, locked columns, default baseline, one sort, hide resets, width versioning, live resize/commit/cancel semantics and rendered-width verification. Describe baseline visibility as registry/seed defaults, retaining admin overrides. Replace moved spec and absent Markdown companion with current manual-case source.

route-security-policy.task_condition: changing explicit REST operations, registry, transport policy, wrappers or OpenAPI policy metadata
route-security-policy.review: Keep registry fields/completeness, REST/MCP split, cache safeguards, auth-CSRF order, derived methods, unknown-operation fallback, wrappers and OpenAPI declarations. Other transport guides point here for authority.

scripts.task_condition: editing JS/MJS scripts; deterministic-code coverage and orchestration-only exclusion remain distinct
scripts.review: Keep changed deterministic code at 85% across four metrics, pure-function extraction, mixed-script handling and orchestration exclusion. Delegate database schema/seed facts to database-schema; keep script execution logic tests permitted.

secure-mutation-routes.task_condition: changing REST mutation authorization, validation, handlers, audit, cache or errors; excludes MCP
secure-mutation-routes.review: Keep wrapper-only REST exports, required bounded policies, no pre-auth work, validation/context shape, audit specialization and focused wrapper/route tests. Reference service boundary for shared workflow transport separation.

tests.task_condition: adding or modifying tests; apply React/Vitest/Playwright/DAL branches only to their frameworks and subjects
tests.review: Keep current-behavior/security-negative assertions, behavioral testing, framework-specific mocks/act, viewport, coverage, DAL and SQL testing. Explicitly prohibit workflow/skill-definition unit tests and automated AI-instruction tests. Keep script and application tests, including actual import-instruction API behavior.

translations.task_condition: changing messages, including UI/help/report labels requiring both locales
translations.review: Keep paired locales, nested keys, JSON validity and interpolation. Remove absent page-specific cookies/privacy/terms file cache; those pages currently use messages/en.json and messages/sv.json.

typeorm-entities.task_condition: authoring EntitySchema metadata, relations, indices, localized fields or entity registration
typeorm-entities.review: Keep EntitySchema file/type/registration/column/relation/index/localized metadata mechanics. Reference database-schema for DDL ownership, naming and scalar FK exceptions. Describe metadata test as naming/table-presence evidence, not full final-schema drift proof.

typeorm-sqlserver.task_condition: changing SQL Server/TypeORM connections, queries, transactions, procedures, migrations, seeds or browse workflow
typeorm-sqlserver.review: Keep Data Mapper/query hierarchy, pooling, transaction manager/QueryRunner mechanics, SQL performance/procedure/security choices, read-only browsing and specialized checks/docs. Delegate schema authority and logical mutation ownership; repair absent script, shallow docs and MJS coverage.

ui-ux.review: Keep responsive, target-size exceptions/evidence, dark mode, accessibility, status contrast, form help, discoverability, interaction/view state, feedback and UI integration coverage. Own product dialogs transferred from Copilot root. Reference Developer Mode for its exception; components owns reduced-motion mechanics. Replace generic direct Playwright invocation with current repository runner pointer.

utilities.task_condition: authoring TypeScript library utilities, including external HTML handling or dynamic import paths
utilities.review: Keep naming/export/types, utility-local test placement, HTML sanitization and dynamic-import path validation. Explicitly preserve area-specific test locations; retain current library-TS scope and conditions.
